crossRefs.note: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.
translations.kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And I have taken the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel.
